grants.note: Demo pipeline service connection. onboard is registry-wide (the rulesets scope never applies to it); update/offboard/bind are limited to the seeded sample-app ruleset; bind lets the pipeline add a second workload to sample-app as the module grows. Rulesets this identity onboards itself are covered by trust-on-first-use ownership, not by this grant.

Demo content-only pipeline: may push allowed_hosts and action, but holds no bind, so it cannot change which workloads a ruleset governs. This is the grant that shows bind is a separate permission rather than part of update.
Demo platform-team identity: unscoped, so it can override any ruleset, including rebinding subjects.
